cards.content: ### 📡 Core Sensors

**Grid**: current grid power. Negative is export, positive is import (W).

**Market/export price**: current market or export price used for PV limiting (€/kWh).

**All-in price**: current total import price used for negative-price override (€/kWh).

**Solar power**: current total PV power from active inverters (W).

Paste (Ctrl + V) the entity IDs in the fields below. 
Example: `sensor.p1_meter_power`
### 🔆 Inverters

Configure up to 10 active inverter limit entities.

For manually configured inverters, enter:

• Control method: Number entity or Action/service.
• For Number entity, enter the writable power-limit entity ID.
• For Action/service, configure the advanced action adapter.
• Limit unit used by the entity (Watt or Percent).
• The maximum power (W).
• The minimum desired power (W).

Paste (Ctrl + V) the entity IDs into the fields below.

cards.content: When the all-in price is ≤ 0 €/kWh, PV is limited to the configured minimum. Set it to 0 W for full shutdown during negative price.
### ⚡ Power Flow Control

**Export start**: start limiting when export is stronger than this value.

**Target export**: export level Home PV Control tries to maintain while limiting. Must be higher (less negative) than Export start.

**Import restore**: raise PV again if the house imports too much while limited.

**Min PV for control**: prevents export limiting when PV is low. Not used for import restore.

**Night restore**: restores full inverter limits after PV stays at or below the configured threshold for a while.

card.content: <ha-alert alert-type="warning">Export start must be lower than Target export, and Target export must be lower than Import restore.</ha-alert>

cards.content: ### 🎚️ Control Tuning

**Cooldown**: minimum time between PV limit changes (10 to 60 sec).

**Deadband**: ignores small differences around Target export so Home PV Control does not react to tiny changes.
### 📈 Price Strategy

**PV limit price**: PV limiting is allowed at or below this market/export price.{% if is_state('switch.hpvc_control_hbc_strategy', 'on') %} HBC Charge takes priority while batteries still have useful charge headroom.{% endif %}
**Price hysteresis**: prevents rapid PV limiting changes when leaving the configured PV limit price zone. Not used for negative-price mode.

<ha-alert title="PV limiting price guidance" alert-type="info">
Use €0.00/kWh if you use a net export-price sensor. For a raw market-price sensor, adjust for fees, compensation, and local rules.
</ha-alert>
